title: qc_results
description: S5 QC results for one match (docs/PHASE0.md S5); copied into run_report.json's qc on every run, including runs that skip S5. Generated from core/contracts.py by `python -m core.contracts`; do not edit by hand.

checks.description: Every S5 check, in the order S5 runs them.

value.description: Measured value (number, text, object, list of spans, or null); numbers are finite.

threshold.description: Threshold the value was compared with, or null.
